import { BaseSubgraph, type SchemaBuilder } from "@powerhousedao/reactor-api";
import { schema } from "./schema.js";
import { getResolvers } from "./resolvers.js";

export class ExampleSubgraph extends BaseSubgraph {
  static override readonly subgraphName = "example";
  static override getSchema(schemaBuilder: SchemaBuilder<ExampleSubgraph>) {
    return schemaBuilder.graphql({
      typeDefs: schema,
      resolverCoordinates: [
        {
          typeName: "Query",
          fieldName: "example",
          resolverKind: "field",
        },
        {
          typeName: "ExampleQueries",
          fieldName: "example",
          resolverKind: "field",
        },
      ],
      resolvers: (s) => getResolvers(s),
    });
  }

  override async onSetup() {
    await super.onSetup();
  }
  override async onDisconnect() {
    await super.onDisconnect();
  }
}
